Digital Marketing Specialist

About Reframe Space

Reframe Space Inc. is a growing, US-based company helping businesses create more flexible and functional workplaces through office sound pods and modular conference rooms.

We are looking for someone to join our remote team who takes initiative, communicates clearly, and follows through consistently.

About the role

We’re looking for someone with B2B digital marketing experience to help grow our online presence, reach potential customers, and generate business opportunities through organic marketing.

We want to understand what you have done, the work you personally handled, and what you learned along the way.

What you’ll do

• Plan and carry out digital marketing activities that build awareness and attract business customers.

• Develop organic outreach efforts and help turn interest into meaningful sales conversations.

• Create and coordinate content that communicates our products and their value.

• Manage our digital presence and keep marketing activities consistent.

• Work with internal teams and external contributors to move projects forward.

• Track results and use what you learn to improve future efforts.

What we’re looking for

• Hands-on experience in B2B digital marketing.

• Experience growing organic reach, engagement, or customer inquiries.

• Strong writing, communication, and organizational skills.

• The ability to work independently and take responsibility for results.

• Experience working with US companies and availability during US business hours.

Relevant freelance, agency, in-house, and project experience are welcome.

How to apply

• Please submit your general résumé without using AI to tailor or optimize it for this job description. We want to understand your actual experience, especially your work growing organic outreach.

About Atlys

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to own critical business data end to end and help teams make better decisions with it.

You’ll build the metrics, dashboards and analyses that become the single source of truth across the business, while partnering closely with teams to solve high-impact problems and uncover growth opportunities.

This role is for someone who can independently navigate messy data, define the right questions, and turn analysis into clear decisions and action.

The Job

• Own business data as a reliable source of truth by ensuring key metrics, reports and dashboards are accurate, consistent and trusted across teams.
• Build and evolve decision-making systems across business, marketing, finance and other core functions through dashboards, reporting and analytical frameworks.
• Turn complex datasets into actionable insights by writing advanced SQL, analysing large datasets, and identifying trends, anomalies and opportunities.
• Define the metrics that matter by partnering with teams to establish KPIs, improve measurement and create clarity around performance.
• Lead data-driven problem solving by independently structuring ambiguous business questions, diagnosing root causes and recommending actions that improve outcomes.

The Ideal Candidate

You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You

• Have 3-6 years of experience in data analytics, business analytics or a similar role, ideally in a fast-moving consumer or technology business.
• Are exceptionally strong in SQL and comfortable independently working with large, complex and imperfect datasets.
• Have strong experience with visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio or Metabase, and can build dashboards that drive decisions rather than just report numbers.
• Bring strong analytical and business judgment, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and translate analysis into clear recommendations for stakeholders.
• Have exposure to Python or a strong understanding of how data flows through products and technology systems.

What You Can Expect

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s What You Can Expect

• Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
• Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
• A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
• Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
• Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
• Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
• Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
• An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

About the Team

GitLab's APJ Ecosystem team builds and scales the partner (channel, alliance, and hyperscaler) motion across the region. India is a strategic market for GitLab, and this hire is central to strengthening our partner ecosystem there — deepening a smaller number of high-value partnerships rather than spreading thin across many transactional ones.

About the Role

The Scale Ecosystem Sales Manager (ESM), India is a senior, market-facing role responsible for building and scaling GitLab's partner business in India across the full breadth of the ecosystem. This role focuses on new logo acquisition and aligns closely with our new business team in India. This will involve working with  hyperscalers, India-centric system integrators (SIs), and born-in-the-cloud / AI-native partners. We are looking for someone with the range and seniority to credibly own strategic partner relationships across all of these partner types, and to help grow our business through these partners.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who has already built a career scaling partner-sourced and influenced revenue in India — someone who knows the hyperscaler ecosystem (AWS & GCP), has deep, credible relationships with India's major SIs, and understands how to engage newer-generation cloud-native and AI partners as they become an increasingly important part of the go-to-market.

What You'll Do

  • Build and scale GitLab's partner-sourced and influence business in India across hyperscalers, large India-centric SIs, and born-in-the-cloud/AI partners.
  • Develop deep, strategic (not transactional) relationships with a focused set of priority partners — joint business plans, QBRs, and named executive sponsorship.
  • Own hyperscaler relationship management and Marketplace motion with AWS and/OR GCP.
  • Build and grow relationships with major India SIs and market-making channel/born-in-the-cloud partners and emerging AI-native partners.
  • Drive partner-sourced pipeline and bookings, and carry a quota tied to partner-sourced/generated revenue.
  • Partner closely with the India sales team to ensure partner-sourced opportunities are properly identified, supported, and closed.
  • Work with the India and APJ Ecosystem team to help shape and refine the India Ecosystem coverage model.
  • Contribute to partner enablement, certification, and go-to-market programs suited to the India market.
  • Report on partner engagement health, pipeline contribution, and progress against strategic-partner milestones.

What We're Looking For

  • 15+ years of experience in channel/alliance/partner management or ecosystem sales, ideally within enterprise software, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Extensive, well-rounded experience scaling a business through partners across hyperscalers, large India-centric SIs, and born-in-the-cloud/AI-native partners — not narrowly specialized in just one partner type.
  • Direct experience managing hyperscaler relationships (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure) including Marketplace motion.
  • A strong, credible existing network among India's major SIs and cloud-native/channel partners, with a track record of moving relationships from transactional to strategic.
  • Comfort carrying a partner-sourced revenue quota and being measured on pipeline origination, not just deal closure.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills — able to align internal sales, marketing, and partner-side stakeholders around joint goals.
  • Native or business-fluent Hindi and strong business English (for regional collaboration with APJ leadership).
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Mumbai OR Delhi.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience at or with a hyperscaler (AWS, GCP) in a partner or alliances capacity.
  • Familiarity with GitLab, DevSecOps, or adjacent developer-tooling ecosystems.
  • Experience helping design or reset a partner coverage model, comfortable building process rather than only inheriting one.

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

  • Joint business plans and an active engagement cadence (e.g., QBRs) in place across priority hyperscaler, SI, and cloud-native/AI partners.
  • Demonstrable movement of key partner relationships from transactional to strategic engagement.
  • Growing partner-sourced pipeline and bookings against quota.
  • Credible input into finalizing the India Ecosystem coverage model, grounded in on-the-ground partner relationships.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave 

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility …

Hello, I’m Ricci, Sales Manager at Customer.io in EMEA! We're expanding our sales team in the United Kingdom and Ireland and seeking motivated and successful Account Executives at the Mid-Market level to join us! This role offers a unique opportunity to take your sales career to the next level, with potential for upward mobility.

As an Account Executive, you’ll represent Customer.io to prospective customers and drive growth within key market segments. This is a full-cycle sales role (prospect, demo, close), where you'll be fielding both inbound and outbound demand.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

Responsibilities:

• Pipeline Development and Management: Build and manage a pipeline through self-sourced leads and SDR-supported leads to drive new customer acquisition.

• Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Lead the entire sales process from prospecting and discovery through demo and closing for deals typically under $50,000 ACV, focusing solely on new business acquisition within targeted accounts.

• Customer Needs Analysis and Solution Alignment: Conduct discovery calls to understand customer business challenges and goals. Position Customer.io's solutions to meet these needs effectively.

• Collaboration and Cross-Functional Feedback: Work closely with the SDR team for lead quality feedback and collaborate with Customer Success and Technical Support for a smooth hand-off post-sale.

• Performance Tracking and Reporting: Own and report on individual sales metrics, including pipeline status and progress towards targets, to support informed decision-making.

• High-Volume Prospecting: Engage in consistent cold and warm outreach to build and maintain a healthy top-of-funnel pipeline.

• Client Relationship Development: Nurture relationships within mid-sized accounts to uncover business needs and drive growth opportunities.

Qualifications:

• Experience: 2+ years of experience in full-cycle B2B SaaS or MarTech sales, handling mid-market accounts

• Location: We are currently hiring for positions based in the UK and Ireland. Candidates must be located in one of these regions to be considered for the role.

• B2B SaaS or MarTech Experience: Proven success in new customer acquisition and closing deals within the B2B SaaS space, preferably MarTech

• Sales Methodology: Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a similar framework that supports consultative selling and discovery to close.

• Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and engaging presence to build rapport with new prospects.

• Problem Solving: Strong ability to identify customer business needs and position relevant solutions effectively to drive acquisition

• Deal Focus: Primarily handles mid-market accounts with shorter sales cycles and lower ACV deals

• Support: Works closely with our SDR team for lead generation, with a balance between inbound and self-sourced opportunities

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. We are offering a compensation package of $95,000 base + $95,000 variable for a total $190,000 OTE USD (or equivalent in local currency), subject to market rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

• 30-minute video call with Recruiter

• 45-minute video call with Hiring Manager

• 60-minute Mock Call w/ Hiring Team

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We are passionate about our core values of Empathy, Transparency, Responsibility, and Awkwardness and are looking for new coworkers to share and build that passion!

ABOUT QUANTUMLOOPAI
QuantumLoopAI is one of the UK's fastest-growing healthtech companies. Our AI-powered platform, EMMA, is used by hundreds of organisations across the UK to manage communications, automate workflows and deliver better outcomes through intelligent automation. Backed by leading investors and scaling rapidly ahead of our Series A, we are building the infrastructure that will define the next generation of AI-driven service delivery.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Our platform handles real, live conversations — and because those conversations matter, quality is critical. Small errors have real consequences. We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to own and grow the automated testing that keeps our voice AI platform reliable.
You will build and maintain automated test coverage across backend and frontend, create automation that places and validates real test calls end to end, and measure the accuracy of the speech-to-text (STT) and text-to-speech (TTS) layers that make the platform work. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where your testing directly protects real users.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Backend and Frontend Test Automation

• Build and maintain automated test coverage across backend services and the frontend, ensuring new features ship without breaking existing behaviour.

• Integrate tests into CI pipelines so quality checks run automatically on every change.

• Work with engineers to turn real-world failures into permanent regression tests.

Voice Pipeline and Call Automation

• Build and run outbound-call automation that places test calls through the live voice pipeline, simulates realistic caller scenarios, and validates the platform's behaviour from start to finish.

• Test the speech-to-text (STT) layer — measuring transcription accuracy and how reliably the platform understands callers.

• Test the text-to-speech (TTS) layer — validating pronunciation, naturalness, and that the voice output behaves correctly.

• Run regression testing across multiple conversation flows and catch behavioural drift after changes.

Quality Evaluation and Defect Management

• Evaluate calls against conversational quality dimensions — accuracy, tone, flow adherence, understanding, hand-off between stages, summaries, outcome handling, call control, and avoiding unnecessary repetition.

• Reproduce, document, and track defects through to resolution, writing clear reproduction steps from real call examples.

• Work with engineers, prompt authors, and the operations team to identify quality issues and build permanent test coverage around them.

Requirements
ESSENTIAL

• 4+ years of hands-on experience in QA automation or software testing with a strong automation focus.

• Strong hands-on Python — you write, debug and maintain test scripts daily, not occasionally.

• Experience writing and maintaining automated test suites across both API and UI layers.

• Comfortable testing REST APIs and working with structured data (JSON).

• Experience with automated web and UI testing frameworks.

• Familiarity with version-control workflows (Git) and continuous-integration pipelines — you have integrated automated tests into CI/CD.

• Solid grasp of QA methodology — test design, regression strategy, and the defect lifecycle.

• Excellent attention to detail and clear written communication.

• Comfortable working remotely and aligning to UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST).

DESIRABLE

• Exposure to voice or conversational AI testing — metrics such as transcription accuracy (WER), naturalness scoring, or response latency.

• Experience with automated or AI-assisted response evaluation.

• Telephony or real-time audio and voice testing experience.

• Experience working with data to gather and verify test evidence programmatically.

• Experience in regulated software environments where quality assurance and compliance processes are important.

• Experience working with distributed or remote teams across multiple time zones.

LOGISTICS

• Education: We value skills and experience over formal qualifications.

• Working arrangements: Fully remote from India, aligned to UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST).

• Start date: Flexible.

Benefits
WHAT WE OFFER

• Competitive package depending on experience

• Potential share options

• Professional development including conference attendance and CPD support

• The opportunity to own test automation for a live voice AI platform at one of the UK's fastest-growing healthtech companies

• Remote working with a collaborative, high-ownership engineering culture

• Direct collaboration with engineering, AI/ML and product teams

HOW WE ARE DIFFERENT
At QuantumLoopAI, you will join a team that is building AI-powered products used by hundreds of organisations across the UK. We move fast, take ownership, and celebrate wins together. Our culture values:

• Impact over optics. We measure success by real outcomes, not busy work

• Transparency. Open communication, honest feedback, shared context

• Ownership. You will have real autonomy to shape your work and our platform

• Learning. We are building something new, and we learn from every experiment

This is a QA role where your work has direct, visible impact. Every test you build protects real users in real conversations. You will not be writing test scripts in isolation — you will be listening to real calls, diagnosing real failures, and building the automation that prevents them from happening again.
DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION
We believe diverse teams build better products. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. If you are excited about this role but do not meet every requirement, we would still love to hear from you.
RECRUITMENT SAFETY NOTICE
QuantumLoopAI will never ask candidates for payment or sensitive financial information during the recruitment process. All official communications come from @quantumloopai.com email addresses.
COME WORK WITH US
Ready to own quality for a live voice AI platform? We would love to hear from you. Questions about this role? Contact
